Results.ReviewText: Love Weber, love the 22” Kettle, but… why would you strip features that have always been associated with the kettle? I have been using the kettle for 40+ years and two features that I’ve always taken for granted are now gone or different. Why? #1-the handle has ALWAYS doubled as a grill tool hook. No bells and whistles necessary, just sized to accept the lioops at the end of my grill tools. Now that has been made impossible with the new grill handle and to get this feature you have to upgrade to the bells and whistles version that transforms the handle to have hooks… c’mon. That’s a basic grill feature and your monetizing of a basic need sours me on a company I have loved for decades (this is my 5th kettle and I have two gas grills as well). #2 the kettle lid has ALWAYS had a hook in the lid aligned with the lid handle in the N/S orientation, but for some unknown reason you now move the hook to the E/W orientation?! Why? I imagine it has to do with the lid catcher for the new bells and whistles version, but that’s a bad reason. Whoever decided that was a good idea should know their base.
Results.Title: Why?

Results.ReviewText: My previous Original Kettle Charcoal 22" Grill fell apart after over 20 years.  I liked the size, the convenience, the ease of care, the ability to replace parts if needed, but most of all the excellent BBQ performance, so I purchased another one!  This time I also purchased a cover to keep it protected from the outdoor elements.  Just used it for the first season annual Mother's Day BBQ.  Once again, grilling was perfection, even son-in-law approved.  I also like how Weber sends me cooking ideas and recipes.  I did have difficulty registering my grill, so I called customer service and in five minutes all was completed.  Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Perfection!
